name: RC-B10-0064/2026 – After § 6 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text: 6a. Deplores the fact that the EU ambassador to Honduras has not been invited to present his credentials for over a year; expresses the hope that this will swiftly take place under the incoming administration;
